recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, warm-toned portrait of a smiling woman set against a dark, vignetted background, featuring a prominent hand-drawn script title in dusty pink and a secondary serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's warm skin tones contrast against the deep black negative space
The organic, fluid script title balances the structured facial features
Soft-focus hair highlights mirror the warm glow on the face
The diagonal lean of the subject creates a dynamic yet intimate composition
coreInvariants: Warm, golden-hour color temperature on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, tightly cropped from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face down to the hand-drawn script in the lower-left corner, then across the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space occupies the left third and top-left corner, providing a canvas for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ambers, golds, and skin tones for the subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty rose/pink for the primary script lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and background; medium saturation in the warm tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, connected cursive with varying stroke thickness.
letterConstructionRules: Rough, textured edges suggesting a dry brush or marker
Lower-case dominance with exaggerated descenders and ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dot on 'i' or 'j' rendered as a soft, irregular circle
Terminal strokes fade out with a textured bleed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, textured script paired with a clean, formal italic serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-drawn, textured feel of the primary title.
Provides the elegant, high-contrast serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with a warm smile, golden-brown hair highlights, leaning her chin near her hand. Lighting is warm and directional, fading into a solid black background on the left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, hand-drawn lowercase script in dusty pink at the bottom left. To its right, add a small, elegant italic serif subtitle in white.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text in a textured, pink script?
Is the background deep black with a soft vignette?
Is the lighting on the subject warm and golden?
Is the subtitle in a small, white italic serif?

adjustableVariables: Texture level of the script font
Specific shade of the pink accent
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or brand logos
Exact facial features of the reference subject

avoid: Generic, clean-edged digital fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between text and background
Ensure the script looks hand-painted rather than typed
Verify the warm color temperature is consistent across the subject
Confirm the composition follows a 1/3 text to 2/3 image ratio
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Portrait + Black Negative Space + Textured Script Typography = Soulful 90s Aesthetic
